research_question: Can Trigger-2 close the D/E labeler blocker without moving invented labels one field upstream?

current_evidence.finding: Supervisor 8.78 quarantines binding-router factorial v3 because conditional nuisance leakage makes target class highly recoverable from nuisance signatures; marginal balance is insufficient.

Current-main adversarial audit ffa12bcc independently finds v1 reference logic circular because update effects and discriminator winner/separation can be caller asserted, and independence/admissibility guards are incomplete.

current_evidence.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere, ICML 2025, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs (arXiv:2505.20896)
current_evidence.finding: Binding training can pass through heuristic phases before a systematic mechanism emerges; causal/mechanistic diagnostics matter in addition to endpoint accuracy.

current_evidence.source: Wei et al., EMNLP 2023, Symbol tuning improves in-context learning in language models (arXiv:2305.08298)
current_evidence.finding: Arbitrary/flipped labels can pressure models to use episode-local mappings rather than semantic label priors; this supports B-style codebook training but does not prove the same mechanism in the target 0.8B model.

current_evidence.source: Prakash et al., ICLR 2026, Language Models Use Lookbacks to Track Beliefs (arXiv:2505.14685)
current_evidence.finding: A large Llama model exhibits causally studied low-rank binding/lookback mechanisms; this motivates binding probes but cannot be transferred as positive evidence to the selected small model.

current_evidence.source: Hoang et al., 2026 preprint, Sparse Autoencoders Encode Both Concepts and Functions (arXiv:2607.24645)
current_evidence.finding: Interpretable features can have context-dependent or diffuse downstream effects, so decodability/readability must not be equated with a stable universal steering direction.

hypothesis: For synthetic D/E episodes, a narrow executable task-world oracle can generate non-circular branch-update/resolution targets more safely than a generic labeler that accepts caller-supplied semantic effects.
counterhypothesis: A perfectly deterministic toy-world oracle may teach a brittle attribute simulator rather than the intended generalized Hyperposition update operation; passing source tests is therefore necessary but far from model/curriculum acceptance.

v2_design.scope: SYNTHETIC_ATTRIBUTE_WORLD/v1 only; deliberately not a generic semantic oracle
v2_design.derivation: Each branch contains an explicit synthetic task world. An ATTRIBUTE_READ discriminator is executed against every branch; prediction, SUPPORT/FALSIFY relation, branch state update, resolution and pair coverage are derived from those executable relations.
anti_circularity: zero surviving branches yields contradiction, not forced winner
provenance_independence: same evidence_id with changed identity fails closed
same independence_group reused for a different observation fails closed
anti_collapse: branch objects are retained after falsification
resolution requires exactly one live branch after derived observations

local_static_execution.scope: LOCAL_DETERMINISTIC_SOURCE_TEST_ONLY; NOT ADMITTED ENTITYOS/HCU/MODEL/TRAINING RUNTIME EVIDENCE
